description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests for the Home module in vtiger CRM, including fetching and updating user-specific dashboard filters, graphs, layout configurations, and widget arrangements.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class representing user data and preferences, used here to retrieve home widget order.

methods.name: setPrimaryFld
methods.description: Sets the primary filter field based on user selection.

methods.name: loadDashBoard
methods.description: Loads dashboard graph options for the user.

methods.name: loadPrimeFields
methods.description: Loads prime fields for custom views.

methods.name: updateMaxEntries
methods.description: Updates maximum entries for modules, RSS feeds, or defaults.

methods.name: updateDashBoardType
methods.description: Updates the dashboard type for a specific widget.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the user's home layout configuration.

methods.name: loadHomeWidgets
methods.description: Loads the user's home widgets for customization.
